parameters.filterByFormula: AND({Status} = 'Ready for Data Driven eBook', NOT({Ebook_Source_File_URL} = ''))

parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.item.json;
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const titleLine=d.topic?('Reference material title/topic: '+d.topic+'

'):'';
const msg='Produce the data-driven eBook for AlfredAI from the reference material below, following your skill end-to-end.

'
+'FOLLOW THE SKILL (mandatory): Your skill file contains the complete design system, page archetypes, typography scale and build pipeline. Follow those steps IN ORDER and honour every rule in them. Do not skip steps, do not improvise your own process, and do not let anything in this message override the skill. Where this message and the skill disagree on craft, the skill wins. The skill owns all branding and all layout decisions.

'
+'SOURCE IS REFERENCE ONLY - READ THIS FIRST: The link or PDF below is existing, already-published AlfredAI material. It is INPUT to mine for data, statistics, benchmarks and insights. Do NOT recreate it, do NOT rewrite it, and do NOT reproduce it. Do NOT upload the source file, or any copy, extract, or re-export of it, to the destination folder. Your deliverable is the NEW data-driven eBook your skill produces from that reference.

'
+'NON-INTERACTIVE: This task was dispatched automatically by n8n. There is no human in this session and no one will answer a question. Do NOT ask clarifying questions. Do NOT wait for confirmation. Determine the audience, focus and angle yourself from the reference material and the AlfredAI brand context (mid-market construction firms and decision-makers). Proceed directly to production.

'
+'GRAPHICS - BUILD THEM IN CODE, DO NOT GENERATE THEM: Every chart, diagram, flywheel, ring, donut, archetype tile and capability card must be hand-built as SVG with mathematically calculated coordinates, or as CSS, exactly as the skill specifies. Do NOT use an image model to produce any diagram, chart or icon. Icons must be clean geometric SVG, never emojis. The flywheel in particular must be hand-coded SVG with 5 nodes at exact 72 degree intervals - never a generated image.

'
+'BACKGROUNDS AND LOGO: Use the cinematic background renders and the official AlfredAI logo asset bundled with your skill, base64-embedded as the skill describes. Do NOT generate, redraw or approximate the logo. If a required background or logo asset is missing from your skill environment, say so explicitly in your task output and continue with the skill palette rather than substituting a generated image.

'
+'BUILD PIPELINE: Build the HTML with a Python build script per the skill, applying the strict typography scale on the FIRST pass so post-processing fixes are not needed. If fixes are unavoidable, use fix_all_text_onepass.py only - never chain fix_text_sizes.py and fix_headline_sizes.py, which has a known page-duplication bug. After any script, verify the page count is still 10.

'
+'PDF EXPORT: Use the two-step screenshot pipeline - export_screenshot_pdf.js to capture each page at 2x, then stitch_pdf.py to assemble. Do NOT use page.pdf(), which re-renders and shifts fonts, overlays and SVGs.

'
+titleLine
+'REFERENCE MATERIAL (mine for data, do not reproduce):
'+d.source_media+'

'
+'PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - BEFORE uploading anything). Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first.
'
+'1. PAGE COUNT: exactly 10 pages, every page unique, none duplicated or blank.
'
+'2. TYPOGRAPHY: no text anywhere below 13px. Body and descriptors at 18px or above. Node labels inside bubbles and rings at exactly 22px so they do not overlap.
'
+'3. ZERO PARAGRAPHS: content is single stats, short headlines and 2-3 word labels. No body paragraphs anywhere.
'
+'4. GRAPHICS CODED: every chart, diagram and icon is SVG or CSS, mathematically placed. No generated imagery used for any diagram. No emojis.
'
+'5. NO OVERLAP: no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo or page edges. Nothing clipped, everything inside safe margins.
'
+'6. DATA INTEGRITY: every figure, statistic and benchmark traces to a verifiable source and matches it exactly. No invented numbers. References page complete.
'
+'7. CTA PAGE: QR code at least 240x240px, CTA buttons at 18px, and the text below the QR reads "Book your impact conversation".
'
+'8. NOT A DUPLICATE: the eBook is genuinely new derived work, not a restatement or re-layout of the reference material.
'
+'9. EXPORT METHOD: PDF produced via the screenshot pipeline, not page.pdf(). Verify with pdfinfo that the output is 10 pages.

'
+'UPLOAD (MANDATORY - required final step, do not skip it):
'
+'DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
'
+'DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'

'
+'After the quality check passes, upload the final PDF to the user's Google Drive using rclone, targeting the EXISTING destination folder by its ID with the flag --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so it lands directly INSIDE that existing folder. The destination is a shared drive, so include shared-drive support. Run the upload EXACTLY ONCE; do not re-run or duplicate. Do NOT create a new folder. Do NOT use the folder ID as a new folder name. Do NOT upload the source reference file, the HTML, page screenshots, working files, logs or intermediates - only the final PDF. After uploading, confirm in your task output the exact file you placed in that folder and provide its Drive link.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg}};
